desc:
[ Confirmed CODE at 15k UPVOTES!! ]


**Controls (PC)**

M1 / M2 - light and heavy combos
1,2,3,4 - skills
F - block (perfect block on timing)
C - charge ki (hold) [Needs Ki Unlocked]
X - Transform
G - See Transformations
U - zone sense (hold to see nearby places, bus stops and your story NPC)


In the world of the strong . . .  will you be the one to come out on top?
